LanguageData.Gun_KRISS_Vector_Gen1_RWP.label: KRISS Vector Gen1
LanguageData.Gun_KRISS_Vector_Gen1_RWP.description: The KRISS Vector Gen1 is a cutting-edge submachine gun known for its unique recoil mitigation design and fast rate of fire. Utilizing a revolutionary Super V system, it redirects recoil energy downwards, allowing for increased accuracy and control. Ideal for short to medium-range engagements, this weapon is lethal in the hands of a skilled shooter.
